Lasting satiety, a balanced formula and appetite control

MCT oils — fats
with a unique metabolic pathway

Medium-chain triglycerides are absorbed quickly and follow a distinct metabolic pathway. Unlike most dietary fats, they reach the liver rapidly, where they are actively drawn into energy metabolism.

  • Immediate ketogenic energy when carbohydrates are restricted (bypassing the lymphatic system → delivered straight to the liver).
  • Lasting satiety thanks to their effect on appetite regulation mechanisms
  • Thermogenic effect — additional calorie expenditure during digestion itself

An expert view on Ketology

When a woman is preparing for pregnancy or recovering after childbirth, we often see the same issues: iron deficiency and its consequences, insufficient protein intake and absorption, and shortfalls in the vitamins needed to build healthy blood. Ketology is an excellent way to effectively address additional protein intake with a complete set of amino acids, as well as an additional source of B vitamins to help prevent deficiency.

Elena Orlova

Biologist, clinical nutritionist and herbalist, specialist in integrative women's health

World-class quality

The Ketology formula was created at the intersection of modern approaches to nutrition and the many years of professional experience of Keforma (Italy) in developing nutrient-dense products.
